description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardService' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardBase' and manages an input method interface with an inner class 'InputMethod' that attaches an IBinder token.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardService
classes.description: An abstract service class for the soft keyboard, managing input method interface and token.

classes.name: InputMethod
classes.description: Inner class extending InputMethodImpl, responsible for attaching the IBinder token.

methods.name: getImeToken
methods.description: Returns the IBinder token associated with the input method.

methods.name: onCreateInputMethodInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the InputMethod class.

methods.name: attachToken
methods.description: Attaches an IBinder token to the InputMethod and updates the service's token.
